title: GM Discovery Facet Binding Matrix
matrix_rule: Facets are explainable read-only projections over independent governed facts. A facet can support GM search and preparation but cannot create canonical distribution, encounter placement, relationship state, identity, personhood, or player visibility.

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Source/governance-supported native or resident presence with independently supported ordinary/common occurrence.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: normally_occurs_here may be asserted only when ordinary-occurrence authority exists

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Presence or allowance is independently supported and ecology is compatible/tolerated, but ordinary/common occurrence is not established.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: presence/allowance authority plus compatible ecological fit
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: can_occur_here may be true while normally_occurs_here remains unknown

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Source-backed migration or seasonal occurrence qualifying separately established scope/range.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit migration/season fact plus required distribution scope
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: current occurrence follows season/activity gate; migration never manufactures endpoints

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Introduced or invasive range relation explicitly supported at the controlling scope.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: range relation remains distinct from habitat compatibility and native status
role is applied only after presence gates; role never creates range

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: GM grouping over independently supported prey/grazing/herbivory/social-herd facts; no one component is inferred from another.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit source/governed trophic or social fact for each surfaced component
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: search facet only after presence authority; herbivore does not automatically mean prey and herd does not mean domestic

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: GM scale/taxonomy grouping for small fauna and invertebrate ecological content.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: classification does not establish world occurrence

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Movement/habitat-medium discovery grouping where independently supported.
Source/governance-supported dangerous-wildlife or encounter-use facet suitable for GM preparation.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit threat/danger/encounter-use evidence; CR or mechanics alone are insufficient
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: danger is a GM-use facet only after presence gates

gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: source/governed extraordinary classification or bounded first-party profile
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: extraordinary classification/environment fit never creates range or stable-ID binding

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Native-lineage and sapient/person-level fauna where each fact is independently authorized.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit sapience/personhood plus explicit native-lineage/distribution authority
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: native, animal ecology, sapience and personhood remain independent dimensions

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Creature may use existing NPC presentation semantics where source/owner/governance supports it.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: NPC presentation changes neither species identity nor geography

gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit pathway eligibility; consent when sapient/person-level
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: eligibility creates no ownership, bond, taming, training, or obedience

gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit pathway eligibility/profile authority; consent when sapient/person-level
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: size, strength or locomotion alone are insufficient and eligibility creates no live mount/work relationship

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Source/governance-supported familiar or supernatural-bond pathway eligibility only.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit familiar/supernatural-bond compatibility; consent when applicable
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: magical/supernatural type alone is insufficient and compatibility creates no bond

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: A source/governed creature predicate is satisfied by an active ENV overlay or local condition.
gm_discovery_facets.minimum_authority: explicit creature-side predicate plus active resolved overlay/condition
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: overlay satisfaction may enable/condition discovery but never creates range, affinity or identity

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Explicit canonical/local presence is retained while ecology is incompatible or materially indeterminate.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: discoverable_with_warning; conflict remains visible with trace and provenance

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: A controlling visibility, explicit absence, ecological exclusion, inactive-current condition, or other authoritative gate blocks normal discovery.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: hidden from normal discovery; authorized diagnostics may expose blocking reason/provenance

gm_discovery_facets.meaning: Material identity, visibility, distribution, ecology, season/activity, or other required authority is missing or conflicting.
gm_discovery_facets.presence_semantics: fail closed; include_unresolved diagnostics may surface the gap instead of guessing
